Title: Erlik's special card ability and Anarch Convert triggers

Messages.Author: Millicent
Messages.Body:
I put in play Erlik and one Anarch Convert on the same turn. I remove the Anarch Convert from the game to make Erlik anarchist and draw a new vampire from the crypt.

Can I use the ability from Erlik to distribute blood on the vampire drawed with the Anarch Convert ?

Name: Erlik
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Harbinger of Skulls
Group: 3
Capacity: 10
Discipline: AUS CEL FOR NEC THN
Sabbat: As Erlik enters play, you can distribute up to 5 blood from him to any of your uncontrolled Harbingers of Skulls. +1 bleed. +1 hand size.

Name: Anarch Convert
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Caittif
Group: Any
Capacity: 1
Discipline:-
Anarch: As the convert enters play, you can remove him from the game to make a non-titled vampire you control Anarch and either gain 1 pool or draw 1 card from your crypt.

Thanks in advance !!

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
No, because you bring out one vampire first, and after that the other one. If Erlik enters the game first, you can use his special only on potential candidates already in the crypt.

Messages.Author: Palamedes
Messages.Body:
> Millicent wrote:
> I can't find another rule about a full blood vamp in uncontrolled region, wich says that this vamp can remain in uncontrolled region. At the beggining, this vamp should go to controlled region.
>
www.vekn.net/rulebook/7-influence-phase

Rulebook:
7. Influence Phase
At any time during this phase, if a vampire has at least as many blood counters as his capacity, the player can move that vampire face up to the ready region, unlocked.

CAN, but not MUST.

However, this has nothing to do with your original question. The vampire ability resolves as soon as the vampire comes into play, and they come one by one. So if Erlik comes first you resolve his ability immediately.

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
> Palamedes wrote:
> www.vekn.net/rulebook/7-influence-phase
>
> Rulebook:
> 7. Influence Phase
> At any time during this phase, if a vampire has at least as many blood counters as his capacity, the player can move that vampire face up to the ready region, unlocked.
>
Also notice the words "at any time". This means that you can sequence things in the influence phase, and bringing vampires up now is a choice, not obligatory. You can bring up anarch convert, turn someone anarch, pull a new card from the crypt, bring up anarch convert to turn that same vampire to anarch, draw a new vampire from the crypt, and move 2 blood to it.

Also worth noting that a vampire can have more blood than its capacity while on the uncontrolled zone, it doesnt "drain off" until you bring them to controlled zone, and you don't have to bring them up. You can use any uncontrolled vampire to "store" pool.

Theres lots of tricks involving crypt now.

ps. The rules involving influence step were changed some time ago. It wasn't always like this. Some old players may remember the old rules.
